actual_outcome:
It is completely understandable to feel exhausted and powerless when you look at all the friction and injustice in the world and wish things were different. Wanting to see fairness and order comes from a deep place, but carrying the weight of the entire world as a personal duty is a massive, crushing burden for anyone to hold.

The reality is that global problems are vast and complex, driven by millions of moving parts.
